system.description:
Gnome

Gnomes are the smallest of the demi-human races, averaging 3 to 3½ feet in height. They are inquisitive, good-natured, and clever, with a love of gems, jokes, and all things mechanical. Gnomes are distantly related to dwarves and share many of their underground sensibilities.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Intelligence: +1
  • Wisdom: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 60 feet.
  • Detect Grade or Slope: On a roll of 1–5 on a d6 when underground.
  • Detect Unsafe Walls, Ceilings, and Floors: On a roll of 1–7 on a d10.
  • Determine Approximate Depth Underground: On a roll of 1–4 on a d6.
  • Determine Approximate Direction Underground: On a roll of 1–3 on a d6.
  • Speak with Burrowing Mammals: Gnomes can communicate with moles, badgers, ground squirrels, and similar creatures.
  • Attack Bonus: +1 to attack rolls vs. kobolds and goblins.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC penalty (bonus) vs. gnolls, bugbears, ogres, trolls, ogre magi, giants, and titans.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: Gnomes receive a bonus to saving throws vs. magic equal to +1 per level of the gnome character (minimum +1).

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Illusionist, Cleric, Thief; Fighter/Illusionist, Fighter/Cleric, Fighter/Thief, Illusionist/Thief multiclass.
